newsitem.title: USA: Hemispherx in $5 mln stock buyback.
newsitem.headline: Hemispherx in $5 mln stock buyback.

text.p: Hemispherx BioPharma Inc said Friday it will repurchase $5 million of its outstanding convertible preferred stock.
The company added that it has simultaneously has placed $5 million of new convertible preferred stock with a group of U.S. institutional funds.
The proceeds of the new placement, said the company, will be used to retire the preferred stock.
The private placement occurs following favorable mention of the company in a recent issue of Business Week.
Hemispherx common stock was also the top percentage gainer at the opening of NASDQ trading on Friday, rising more than 25 percent to 2-3/4, a gain of 5/8 from Thursday's closing price.
The company is a biopharmaceutical firm with more than 230 patents, specializing in drug treatment technology for chronic debilitating viral disorders and severe defects in the human immune system.
